name: UK crypto-sector salary conversion and laundering exposure

attribution.legal_posture: Official foreign-government, police, CERT, sanctions, or security-service guidance/assessment

caveats: Salary-to-cryptoasset movement is a review signal; customer or worker intent requires independent evidence.
The UK sanctions-supervisor assessment describes DPRK IT-worker cryptocurrency and fiat-to-crypto conversion risks; additional incident status requires separate evidence.
Use this for risk controls, transaction review and sanctions escalation rather than public accusation.

statements: OFSI's official 2025 sector assessment describes DPRK IT workers as a revenue stream and identifies indirect fiat-to-crypto conversion and virtual-asset laundering exposure, providing a financial-control perspective not captured by the UK hiring alert alone.

sources.support: OFSI's official 2025 sector assessment describes DPRK IT workers as a revenue stream and identifies indirect fiat-to-crypto conversion and virtual-asset laundering exposure, providing a financial-control perspective not captured by the UK hiring alert alone
